result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with nothing left.

I added `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query in `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. For WH-1 in your example, only "Bolt 10" is listed.

The quantity lookup for a single product and warehouse is a separate query that I didn't touch. I didn't check it by hand, but nuts in WH-1 should still answer 0.

The full offline test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) ran with no failures. I didn't add a new test for the zero-quantity case, and I didn't commit.
